Providers

Airtel Malawi
Mobile · customers (company-reported, 2025 Annual Report)
Malawi's largest mobile operator, listed on the Malawi Stock Exchange and part of Airtel Africa. Reported 8.8 million customers in its 2025 Annual Report (year ended 31 December 2025), up 8.3% year-on-year — an officially published, audited figure.
Rate by email →
TNM (Telekom Networks Malawi)
Mobile · GSM subscribers (press paraphrase of FY2025 results)
Malawi's other major mobile operator — together with Airtel Malawi it forms a tight duopoly on the MNO market, per independent industry analysis. TNM's own 2025 Annual Report reports its mobile and mobile-money (Mpamba) customer bases each grew by more than 1 million users during 2025; press coverage of those results put the year-end GSM subscriber count at roughly 7 million, though that headline figure is a news paraphrase rather than a number stated verbatim in the annual report itself.
Rate by email →
Malawi Telecommunications Limited (MTL)
Fixed/Mobile · no public subscriber count
State-linked fixed-line, mobile and ICT provider, a subsidiary of Press Corporation Plc. No subscriber or customer total is disclosed in Press Corporation's public materials, MTL's own site, or any MACRA publication found for this build.
Rate by email →
Starlink
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Satellite internet service. MACRA granted Starlink its first satellite broadband licenses (Network Facilities, Network Services and Application Service) on 21 October 2022, and the service went live commercially around mid-2023 — the fifth African country with access at that point. No Malawi-specific subscriber count has been published.
